# markdown-it 15.0.3

Browser UMD bundle and source map copied from the pinned official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-15.0.3.tgz

Upstream: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it
License: MIT; see LICENSE.

The game uses this local copy for AI answer Markdown. Raw HTML is disabled; images render as text, and links allow only HTTP/HTTPS. No CDN is contacted at runtime.
